question: As of July 2023, who was the Member of Parliament from the parliamentary constituency of Varanasi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narendra Modi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Narendra Modi, the current Prime Minister of India, has been serving as the Member of Parliament (MP) for the Varanasi constituency since 2014.
 
• Varanasi is considered one of the most prominent and sacred cities in India, often referred to as the spiritual capital of the country.
 
• PM Modi contested and won the Varanasi seat during the 2014 and 2019 General Elections with a significant majority.
 
• His leadership in Varanasi has been focused on infrastructure development, cultural preservation, and boosting tourism in the city.
 
• Key projects under Modi's tenure include the Kashi Vishwanath Corridor, Ganga rejuvenation efforts, and various urban development initiatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kashi Vishwanath Corridor:**

 
 
• A significant redevelopment project launched by PM Modi in Varanasi aimed at enhancing the infrastructure around the Kashi Vishwanath Temple.
 
• The corridor connects the temple to the Ganga River, improving accessibility for pilgrims and tourists.
 
• It is a major cultural and religious initiative to preserve India's heritage.
 
 
 
• **Namami Gange Programme:**
 
 
• Launched in 2014 under PM Modi's government to rejuvenate and clean the Ganga River.
 
• It includes projects such as wastewater treatment, riverfront development, and biodiversity conservation.
 
• Varanasi has been one of the key focal points of this initiative.
 
 
 
• **Varanasi Smart City Project:**
 
 
• Under the Smart Cities Mission, Varanasi has seen infrastructural upgrades, including better roads, lighting, and urban amenities.
 
• The project focuses on enhancing the city's livability while preserving its cultural significance.
 
 
 
• **Historical Significance of Varanasi:**
 
 
• Varanasi is one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world.
 
• It is deeply rooted in Hinduism and Buddhism, serving as a major pilgrimage site.
 
• The city attracts millions of domestic and international tourists annually.
